notes.title: Version: 1.0.5
notes.notes: [p]The new update adds lava and ice zombies. Lava zombies most often appear between houses in the yard. Be careful, lava zombies do the most damage. Ice zombies appear on the roads, they are just as dangerous, but do less damage than lava zombies. The normal zombie appears near your spawn point and does the least damage.[/p]

notes.title: Version: 1.0.4
notes.notes: [p]The new update adds a zombie mode. Zombies hear the sound of a shot and move towards you if you are close. After a shot and hitting a zombie next to you, the zombie also reacts to you. If after a shot at a large distance in a zombie and the zombie does not see you, then they run away. Do not let the zombie get close to you, it will hold you until you jump. Sometimes a zombie is enough to hit you once and that's it, the game is over.[/p]

notes.title: Version: 1.0.3
notes.notes: [p]The new update adds day and night. Now during the match there will be a cycle of changing day and night.[/p][p]Flashlight and laser for weapons have been added. Select the flashlight or laser, then press the 4 key to turn it on.[/p]

notes.title: Version: 1.0.2
notes.notes: [p]A major update adds shaders and textures to improve visuals.[/p][p]Explore the area: Visit training grounds to familiarize yourself with the terrain and prepare your tactics.[/p]

notes.title: Version: 1.0.1
notes.notes: While the online is small, changes have been made to the match selection. Now you can start a match with a small number of people. Select the number of players to start the match and start searching for matches. Rating is disabled until there are enough players for rating.
